c1-34-01.title: Communicative Challenge: How Sure Is the Discovery
c1-34-01.scenario: You listen to a talk about Polányi Mihály and tacit knowledge. A friend asks whether a discovery came from intuition.
c1-34-01.prompt: Tell your friend how sure you are.
cues: Say what the discovery may rest on
Say that you are not certain
c1-34-01.target: Nem zárható ki, hogy a kutató hallgatólagos tudásra támaszkodott.
c1-34-01.english: It cannot be ruled out that the researcher relied on tacit knowledge.
c1-34-01.canDo: I can say how sure I am about a claim on knowledge (*feltehetőleg*, *nem zárható ki, hogy*).

c1-34-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Testing a Theory
c1-34-02.scenario: After a talk about Popper's rule, a friend asks what a good scientist does with a mistake.
cues: Say what the scientist does with the mistake
c1-34-02.target: A tévedést beismerve a tudós megőrzi a hitelét.
c1-34-02.english: By admitting the mistake, the scientist keeps their credibility.
c1-34-02.canDo: I can say how a scientist works with a *-va/-ve* participle (*az elméletet cáfolatnak kitéve*, *a tévedést beismerve*).

c1-34-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Honest Research
c1-34-03.scenario: A friend asks what a researcher must not do with the data.
c1-34-03.prompt: Tell your friend what is not allowed.
c1-34-03.english: The data must not be falsified.
c1-34-03.canDo: I can say what a researcher must and must not do (*köteles*, *kénytelen*, *nem szabad*).

c1-34-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A New Paradigm
c1-34-04.scenario: A friend asks what a new paradigm did to science.
c1-34-04.prompt: Tell your friend how much the concepts changed.
cues: Say what the new paradigm did
c1-34-04.target: Az új paradigma számottevően megváltoztatta a tudomány fogalmait.
c1-34-04.english: The new paradigm changed the concepts of science considerably.
c1-34-04.canDo: I can say how strongly a new theory changed science (*számottevően*, *drasztikusan*).

c1-34-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Freedom of Research
c1-34-05.scenario: After reading about Polányi Mihály, a friend asks when science develops well.
c1-34-05.target: A tudomány fejlődik, feltéve, hogy a kutatók szabadon dolgozhatnak.
c1-34-05.english: Science advances, provided that researchers can work freely.
c1-34-05.canDo: I can state a condition and an exception for the freedom of research (*feltéve, hogy*, *kivéve, ha*).

c1-34-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Planning Science
c1-34-consolidation.scenario: A friend asks you to sum up what Polányi Mihály said about planning science.
c1-34-consolidation.prompt: Tell your friend in one or two sentences.
c1-34-consolidation.target: Polányi szerint a tudományt nem lehet felülről megtervezni, mert a felfedezéseket nem lehet előre látni.
c1-34-consolidation.english: According to Polányi, science cannot be planned from above, because discoveries cannot be foreseen.
c1-34-consolidation.canDo: I can use the words for tacit knowledge, testing, research ethics, paradigm shifts and the freedom of research.
